description: Kāneʻohe’s library reopening is worth celebrating, but the long delay raises a bigger question: why did a “simple” fix take nearly 2.5 years? Our community deserves more than last-minute updates. We deserve clear communication, accountability, and real transparency in how public projects and taxpayer dollars are managed.
